initialExam.title: Indian Army MNS (Military Nursing Service) 2026
initialExam.description: Military Nursing Service recruits B.Sc Nursing graduates for commissioned officer posts in Army hospitals.
initialExam.eligibility: B.Sc Nursing with 60% marks, registered with Indian Nursing Council
initialExam.syllabus: GK, English, Nursing, Biology, Chemistry, Physics.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → Personal Interview → Medical Exam → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Nursing Officer (Lieutenant equivalent) in Army hospitals
initialExam.careerGrowth: Lieutenant → Captain → Major → Lt Colonel → Colonel → Brigadier.
initialExam.perks: MSP, DA, Free rations, Accommodation, CSD, Medical, Pension
